evidence: Lighthouse reports ARIA roles are not contained by their required parent element.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may not receive the intended list structure correctly.
recommended_fix: Use semantic ul/li elements or correct ARIA structure.

evidence: Lighthouse reports aria-hidden=true elements contain focusable descendants; failing element is #trending-item-0.
user_impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users may encounter interactive content hidden from assistive technology.
recommended_fix: Do not place focusable elements inside aria-hidden containers; manage focus correctly.

user_impact: Users with low vision or color-vision difficulties may have difficulty reading the text.
recommended_fix: Adjust foreground/background colors to meet WCAG contrast requirements.

evidence: Lighthouse reports touch targets do not have sufficient size or spacing. Failing elements include footer links and accordion buttons.
user_impact: Users on touch devices may have difficulty accurately activating small controls.
recommended_fix: Increase the size and/or spacing of interactive touch targets.

evidence: Lighthouse reports that the document does not have a main landmark; failing element is html.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may have difficulty quickly navigating to the main content.
recommended_fix: "Add an appropriate main landmark such as a semantic main element around the primary content."
